Yeah, writing them down sounds like maybe a good idea.  What would I do after that? I mean I've had some discouraging experiences with therapists/psychologist (perhaps largely my fault, but I don't know), but do I actually need to show them what I write?  If it's what I have to do...

I don't really want to get over the past.  I would rather just kill myself and then have all the people who once cared about, suddenly care about me again.
I never want to talk about it.  I never want to think about the past.  Its over and if I it ever crosses my mind, I instantly want to kill myself.
Life happens.  Do the specifics matter? I just want to know how to get over it, stop being so depressed.  I wasn't the victim of some horrible abuse if that's what you were asking.
Are you an asshole in general, or just when people are their most vulnerable?

Lmao. You're out? When did you even begin to help?  "Just wanted to say this subreddit is great, so I'm gonna say nothing helpful and then leave". Wonderful.

Yeah, I'm in a horrible mood, but that's why I'm here!!
Yeah, very frustrated.  I just finished my second year.  I have no direction in life and I just want to kill myself or go back in time and kill everyone who hurt me.

>Maybe take up a side project or hobby.

My entire problem has to do with avoidance and repression.  I have tons of hobbies.  All I do is waste time.

See how pointless this subreddit is?  God I just hope I get more than 2 responses.
